bullets.text: A road cave-in on Velachery Main Road near Phoenix Marketcity brought traffic to a halt, and the office should monitor Metrowater repairs.
Tiruvallur Collector S. Kavitha declared a school holiday on Monday due to heavy rain forecasts, and the district team must watch weather alerts.
The Meteorological Department predicts very heavy rain in Chennai, Chengalpattu, Kancheepuram, and Tiruvallur districts, and our office should watch for disruptions.
Spot-billed pelicans resting on high-tension towers in Pallikaranai marshland are facing electrocution hazards, and the constituency team should coordinate a safety fix.
The Tamil Nadu Vanigar Sangaangalin Peramaippu Youth Wing organized an anti-drugs awareness marathon in Besant Nagar, and our office should support such public campaigns.
India data centre capacity may reach 2 GW in 2026 as artificial intelligence and cloud computing demand surges, and the portfolio team should track infrastructure growth.
The Global Startup Summit 2026 is scheduled for November 14 at Holiday Inn Chennai OMR IT Expressway, and the office should prepare for founder and investor engagements.
